name: Nakai (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Nakai town emblem in red: a ring divided by a vertical bar, like the character 中.
history: Municipal flag of Nakai, a town in Kanagawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 May 1963.

features.role: Nakai town emblem — a ring divided by a vertical bar, like the character 中
